_comment: Oracle of Sevens style bible and per-slot prompts (from docs/09). Core slot catalogue: core/assets/slots.v1.json. Render: tools/assets/prompts.py --game seventh_veil.

style.theme: A mystic tarot reading behind the seventh veil. An oracle's table at night, with candle smoke, a moonlit sky and gilded cards. Mature and elegant: quiet mystery, not horror.
style.light: Soft candle light from below plus cool moonlight from above. Gold catches the light; no hard white highlights.
style.line: Engraved gold linework like a gilded card edge, fine painterly detail, faint paper and velvet grain. Bold shapes, readable at 128 px.
avoid: cartoon, chibi or child-like faces and proportions (no child appeal)
Stake or Engine logos and any real brand
text, letters or numbers in any image
copies of real tarot decks: original designs only
photo realism, neon cyber looks, emoji-like icons, stock gradients
style.suffix: , original mystic tarot artwork, engraved antique gold linework, deep indigo and veil violet with moon silver accents, soft candlelight and moonlight rim light, painterly fine detail, elegant mature mood, no text, no letters, no numbers --raw --v 8.2 --s 150 --seed 7777
style.cutout: isolated object centered on a plain flat black background, whole object visible, no glow, no shadow, no frame
style.heroScene: an oracle's round table at night under a veil of violet silk, seven tarot cards fanned out, a crystal ball glowing softly, a full moon through tall arched windows
